lines.tts: Ten thousand years ago, Brok needed goats. Kira had ten.
lines.text: Ten thousand years ago, Brok needed goats. Kira had ten.

lines.tts: [pleading] Lend me your goats? I'll give 'em back after winter!
lines.text: Lend me your goats? I'll give 'em back after winter!

lines.tts: Spring came. Brok brought back ten goats...
lines.text: Spring came. Brok brought back ten goats...

lines.tts: [suspicious, dry] Whose damn babies are those?
[defensive] Your goats did it! Not me!
lines.text: Your goats did it! Not me!

lines.tts: So Kira kept the babies. That's how interest was born.
lines.text: So Kira kept the babies. That's how interest was born.

lines.tts: In ancient Sumer, the word for interest literally meant... baby goat.
lines.text: In ancient Sumer, the word for interest literally meant... baby goat.

lines.tts: [building, faster] Ten goats became twenty-four. Then fifty-eight. Then a hundred and forty.
lines.text: Ten goats became twenty-four. Then fifty-eight. Then a hundred and forty.

lines.tts: That's compound interest. Your money has babies... and the babies have babies.
lines.text: That's compound interest. Your money has babies... and the babies have babies.

lines.tts: [sheepish] Kira... can I borrow ten more?
lines.text: Kira... can I borrow ten more?

lines.tts: [dry, deadpan] Sure. Two babies per goat. Sign the damn rock.
lines.text: Sure. Two babies per goat. Sign the damn rock.
